# er605_virtual_server (Resource)

Transmission > NAT > Virtual servers (port forwarding).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "er605_virtual_server" "web" {
  name          = "web"
  interface     = "WAN1"
  external_port = "8443"
  internal_port = "443"
  ipaddr        = "192.168.0.10"
  protocol      = "TCP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_port` (String) port or range a-b
- `interface` (String) e.g. WAN1
- `internal_port` (String)
- `ipaddr` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `protocol` (String) TCP, UDP or ALL

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Rows are imported by their key value (the router has no stable row id).
terraform import er605_virtual_server.web web
```
